title: Voice bot goldset case
description: One item of a tests/goldset/cases/*.yaml list. Enforced by scripts/run_goldset.py:parse_case (the local venv has no jsonschema); tests/unit/test_goldset_assertions.py pins that the key sets here and in the code are the same.

network.description: 'both' (default) plays the case once per network; a list plays it only there.

sales_enabled.description: Value of tenants.config.sales_enabled the case is written for. false = today's fitting-only scope.

pending.description: '<wave checklist>: <reason>' — the case needs a wave that has not landed; it is skipped with this reason in the report.

source.description: tshina:<case id> | prod:<call id prefix> | owner:<decision>

mocks.description: tool name -> result returned instead of the default sandbox mock.

promotions.description: The network's promotions for this case (src.agent.promotions.ActivePromotion), used instead of the promotions table when sales_enabled. Absent = none. One past valid_to is not passed — an expired promotion is written as its absence.

expect_by_network.description: Per-network expectations merged over expect: lists add up, scalars override.

overrides.description: standard network conditions the promotion beats (promo_overrides)

mention_brands.description: brands the promotion is about; a free-delivery promotion covers only these

args.description: argument -> regex over its string value

must_contain.description: every regex must match the reply (case-insensitive)

must_not_contain.description: no regex may match the reply

tool_called.description: each spec must be met by a call on this turn

transfer_reason.description: transfer_to_operator called with exactly this reason

network_leak.description: default true: no phrase of another network in the reply
